shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.position-do.note: Accessible label for the vertical position slider of a point in the shape studio.

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.preview.note: Heading of the area showing the shape on a sample card. Noun.

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.preview-at-.note: Accessible name of the preview. {name} is the size name, {w} and {h} are width and height in pixels.

vars.h: The value that replaces h in the text.
vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.
vars.w: The value that replaces w in the text.

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.previous.note: Button that selects the previous point on the outline. Pair of Next.

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.redo.note: Toolbar button that reapplies the change that was just undone (verb).

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.reload.note: Button that loads the changed library shape again after it was edited elsewhere (verb).

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.remove-poin.note: Button that deletes the selected point from the outline (verb).

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.replaced-yo.note: Confirmation message in the shape studio after a preset or saved shape replaced the current outline.

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.replaces-yo.text: Replaces your current outline. Undo brings it back.
shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.replaces-yo.note: Hint under a preset or library shape in the shape studio. Warns it replaces the outline and that Undo restores it.

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.reset.note: Short button that returns a field or the corner values to their defaults (verb).

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.reset-shape.note: Button that returns the whole outline to the shape it started from (verb plus noun).

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.resize-wind.note: Accessible name of the corner handle that drags the editor window to a new size.

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.restore-siz.note: Window button that returns the maximised editor to its normal size. Opposite of Maximise.

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.reverse-dir.note: Button that flips the order of the points, so the outline runs the other way round.

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.right.note: Label for the right side of the card, or the right anchor option. Not the word for correct.

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.ring-border.text: Ring, border, shadow and value background follow the outline.
shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.ring-border.note: Hint in the shape studio. Tells the user the card's ring, border, shadow and value background take the custom outline.

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.save.note: Button that saves the shape to the library under the typed name (verb).

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.save-a-shap.text: Save a shape here and use it on any dashboard.
shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.save-a-shap.note: Empty-state hint in the shape studio library panel. Explains saved shapes can be reused on any dashboard.

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.save-as-a-c.note: Button that saves the edited shape as a new library entry and leaves the original untouched.

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.save-as-new.note: Shorter button that saves under a new name instead of overwriting the opened library shape.

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.save-curren.note: Heading of the save form in the shape studio library panel. Introduces saving the outline being edited.

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.save-to-lib.note: Button in the shape studio. Saves the current outline to the shared shape library.

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.saved.note: Status label meaning the shape matches the library copy. Past participle.

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.saved-shape.text: Saved shape "{id}" was not found. This card uses its own copy.
shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.saved-shape.note: Warning when a library shape is missing. {id} is the saved shape's identifier, shown in straight quotes.

vars.id: The value that replaces id in the text.

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.saved-to-li.text: Saved to library as {name}. Press Done to use it on this card.
shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.saved-to-li.note: Confirmation after saving. {name} is the saved shape name. Done is the button label.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.search-my-s.note: Placeholder of the search box in the shape studio library panel. Filters the saved shapes by name.

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.select.note: Toolbar tool for selecting points without moving them (verb).

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.selected-po.note: Heading of the panel that shows the position and type of the currently selected point.

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.shape.note: Title word for a single shape, used in headings and tabs. Noun, singular.

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.shape-appli.note: Confirmation after Done. {target} names what got the shape, for example the card or a button.

vars.target: The value that replaces target in the text.

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.shape-edito.note: Title of the shape editor window.

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.shape-for-t.note: Window title. {target} names what the shape belongs to, for example the card or a button.

vars.target: The value that replaces target in the text.

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.shape-name.note: Label of the text field where the user names the shape before saving it to the library.

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.shape-to-co.note: Label of the dropdown that picks the second shape to merge with the outline.

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.shape-type.note: Label of the choice between Corners and Free shape.

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.shapes.note: Heading or tab name for the list of shapes. Plural noun.

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.short-no-sl.text: Short, no slashes. Shown in the list.
shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.short-no-sl.note: Hint under the name field of the save form in the shape studio. Asks for a short name without slashes, used in the library list.

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.shortcuts.note: Heading of the list of keyboard shortcuts. Plural noun.

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.show-full-m.note: Link that expands a long message that was cut short in the Messages list.

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.show-older-.note: Toggle that previews the shape the way older browsers draw it, with straight facets instead of curves.

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.show-text-a.note: Toggle that overlays the area where card text can sit inside the outline.

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.shown-at-pc.note: Lower-case suffix on the preview. {pct} is the zoom percentage, a plain number without the percent sign.

vars.pct: The value that replaces pct in the text.

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.side-panel.note: Accessible name of the panel beside the canvas. Same English as the lips key.

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.sidebar.note: Accessible name of the sidebar landmark that holds the shape list and library tabs.

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.size.note: Label of the dropdown for the preview card size (Small, Medium, Large or Custom).

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.skip-to-can.note: Hidden link for keyboard users that jumps focus to the drawing canvas.

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.skip-to-ins.note: Hidden link for keyboard users that jumps focus to the inspector panel.

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.skip-to-poi.note: Hidden link for keyboard users that jumps focus to the fields of the selected point.

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.smooth.note: Point type option that makes the outline curve through the point. Adjective. Opposite of a sharp corner.

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.smoothing.note: Label of the slider for how strongly the pen rounds the corners of a drawn outline. Noun.

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.snap.note: Toggle that makes dragged points jump to the grid (verb).

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.space-for-t.note: Heading of the section about padding that keeps text away from cut edges.

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.space-for-t.text: Space for text: top, right, bottom, left
shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.space-for-t.note: Accessible name of the four padding fields. The order top, right, bottom, left is the order of the fields.

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.square-corn.note: Hint in the shape studio corner panel. Explains why the size field is disabled for square corners.

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.start-from.note: Short menu button that opens a list of starter shapes. Dots mean a further choice follows. Same idea as the longer variants.

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.start-from-.note: Menu button that opens the list of starter shapes. Dots mean a further choice follows. Variant without dots is a separate key.
Heading or accessible name of the starter shape picker, without dots. Variant with dots is a separate key.

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.started-fro.text: Started from Circle. On a wide card the custom shape is a pill, not an ellipse.
shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.started-fro.note: Note in the shape studio after starting from the Circle preset. Explains the custom shape becomes a pill on a wide card.
Confirmation after picking a starter. {k} is the starter shape name, for example Circle.

vars.k: The value that replaces k in the text.

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.started-fro.text: Started from {k}. Switched to Free shape.
shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.started-fro.note: Confirmation after picking a starter that needs hand-edited points. {k} is the starter name. Free shape is a type name.

vars.k: The value that replaces k in the text.

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.started-fro.text: Started from {name}. It opens as a path, so you can move every point.
shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.started-fro.note: Confirmation after picking a starter. {name} is the starter shape name, for example Cloud.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.started-fro.text: Started from {name}. Your changes make this shape custom.
shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.started-fro.note: Confirmation after picking a starter that stays a corner shape. {name} is the starter shape name.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.started-fro.text: Started from Notch. Its corners are cut straight, so they start as Bevel.
shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.started-fro.note: Note in the shape studio after starting from the Notch preset. Explains the corners begin as Bevel.

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.starters.note: Heading of the group of ready-made shapes to begin from. Plural noun.

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.stays-the-s.text: Stays the same on every card size.
shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.stays-the-s.note: Hint under a size field in the shape studio. Says the value is fixed in pixels and does not scale with the card.

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.stretch.note: Anchor option where the point moves in proportion to the card size, so it stretches with the card.

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.tab-into-th.text: Tab into the canvas. [ and ] choose a point. Arrows move it.
shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.tab-into-th.note: Keyboard help in the shape studio. Tells keyboard users how to enter the canvas, choose a point and move it.

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.the-corners.text: The corners cut into the text area. Raise the extra space or make corners smaller.
shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.the-corners.note: Warning in the shape studio when corners overlap the text area. Suggests raising the extra space or shrinking the corners.

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.the-outline.note: Warning about a self-crossing outline. {where} is a position such as a point number or coordinates.

vars.where: The value that replaces where in the text.

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.the-outline.text: The outline cuts into the text area at {where}. Raise Extra space, or give the card a minimum height.
shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.the-outline.note: Warning. {where} is a position such as a point number or coordinates. Extra space is a field label.

vars.where: The value that replaces where in the text.

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.the-path-ed.text: The path editor could not load. Check your connection and try again.
shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.the-path-ed.note: Error in the shape studio when the point editor code fails to load. Suggests checking the connection and retrying.

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.the-result-.text: {c, plural, one {The result needs # point. A card shape can have {max}. Nothing was changed. Try a smaller or simpler shape.} other {The result needs # points. A card shape can have {max}. Nothing was changed. Try a smaller or simpler shape.}}
shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.the-result-.note: Combine error. {c} is the points the result would need, {max} the largest allowed, a plain number.

vars.c: The count the text is about.
vars.max: The value that replaces max in the text.

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.the-shape-e.text: The shape editor could not load. Check your connection and try again.
shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.the-shape-e.note: Error in the shape studio when the whole editor code fails to load. Suggests checking the connection and retrying.

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.these-shape.text: These shapes have too many points to combine. Nothing was changed.
shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.these-shape.note: Message in the shape studio when a combine operation is refused for complexity. Says the shape was left as it was.

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.this-shape-.text: This shape is too big for the library (8 KB).
shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.this-shape-.note: Save error shown in the studio window. The 8 KB limit is fixed text. Same English as the names key used by the save path.

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.this-shape-.text: This shape was changed somewhere else.
shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.this-shape-.note: Notice in the shape studio when the saved library shape was edited elsewhere, for example on another dashboard.

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.ticket-wave.text: Ticket, Wave and Blob can't be edited yet. Use the preset as it is.
shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.ticket-wave.note: Notice in the shape studio when one of these presets is chosen. Tells the user the preset can only be used unchanged.

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.top.note: Label for the top side of the card, or the top anchor option. Same English as the names key.

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.try-again.note: Button that repeats a failed load of the editor tools (verb phrase).

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.type.note: Short field label for the kind of corner style (Round, Bevel, Cut and so on). Noun.

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.undo.note: Toolbar button that reverses the last change (verb).

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.unit.note: Label of the choice between pixels and percent for a corner size or position.

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.update-name.note: Button that overwrites the opened library shape. {name} is that shape's name, shown in straight quotes.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.use-follows.text: Use follows the library: change "Lamp" and every card that uses it changes. Use as copy makes the card independent.
shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.use-follows.note: Help text in the shape studio library panel. Explains the difference between Use, which stays linked, and Use as copy, which does not.

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.use-on-this.note: Button on a library row that applies the saved shape to the card being edited.

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.vertical-an.note: Field label for which edge a point stays attached to when the card resizes in height (Top, Centre, Bottom).

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.warning.note: Severity label before a warning in the Messages list. Noun, not a verb.

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.width.note: Field label for the width of the custom preview size, in pixels.

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.working.note: Busy label on a button while a combine or import runs. The dots show it is still in progress.

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.x-from-the-.note: Accessible name of the X coordinate field. X is the axis letter; the distance is measured from the left edge.

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.x-y.note: Coordinate pair of a point. {x} is the horizontal and {y} the vertical position, plain numbers.

vars.x: The value that replaces x in the text.
vars.y: The value that replaces y in the text.

shape-editor.mc-shape-studio.y-from-the-.note: Accessible name of the Y coordinate field. Y is the axis letter; the distance is measured from the top edge.

shape-editor.names.a-quarter-circle.note: Description of the Round corner style in the shape studio corner panel.

shape-editor.names.a-quarter-circle-cut-.text: A quarter circle cut into the card.
shape-editor.names.a-quarter-circle-cut-.note: Description of the Scoop corner style in the shape studio corner panel.

shape-editor.names.a-softer-round-betwee.text: A softer round, between a circle and a square.
shape-editor.names.a-softer-round-betwee.note: Description of the Squircle corner style in the shape studio corner panel.

shape-editor.names.a-square-step-cut-int.text: A square step cut into the corner.
shape-editor.names.a-square-step-cut-int.note: Description of the Notch corner style in the shape studio corner panel.

shape-editor.names.a-straight-diagonal-c.note: Description of the Bevel corner style in the shape studio corner panel.

shape-editor.names.arrow.note: Name of a starter shape that looks like an arrow. A shape name.

shape-editor.names.arrow-keys-move-the-p.text: Arrow keys move the point. Shift moves it further, Alt moves it less.
shape-editor.names.arrow-keys-move-the-p.note: Keyboard help line for the shape studio canvas. Explains arrow keys move the point and Shift and Alt change the step.

shape-editor.names.bevel.note: Name of a corner style with a straight diagonal cut.

shape-editor.names.bottom.note: Label for the bottom side of the card. Same English as the studio key.

shape-editor.names.bottom-left-corner.note: Label for the bottom left corner in the shape studio corner panel and its accessible name.

shape-editor.names.bottom-right-corner.note: Label for the bottom right corner in the shape studio corner panel and its accessible name.

shape-editor.names.chevron.note: Name of a starter shape that looks like a chevron, a V-shaped arrowhead.

shape-editor.names.circle.note: Name of a starter shape that is a perfect circle.

shape-editor.names.cloud.note: Name of a starter shape that looks like a cloud.

shape-editor.names.combine.note: Name of the Combine tool in the shortcut and menu list. Same English as the studio key.

shape-editor.names.ctrl-z-undoes-ctrl-sh.text: Ctrl+Z undoes, Ctrl+Shift+Z redoes, Ctrl+S saves.
shape-editor.names.ctrl-z-undoes-ctrl-sh.note: Keyboard shortcut help in the shape studio. Lists the keys for undo, redo and save.

shape-editor.names.custom.note: Label for a shape the user has changed, no longer a plain starter. Adjective.

shape-editor.names.custom-size.note: Preview size option that lets the user type their own width and height.

shape-editor.names.cut-corners.note: Name of a starter shape, a rectangle with diagonally cut corners.

shape-editor.names.delete-removes-the-po.note: Keyboard help line for the shape studio canvas. Tells the user the Delete key removes the selected point.

shape-editor.names.distance-from-the-bot.note: Accessible label for the field that sets a point's distance from the bottom edge in the shape studio.

shape-editor.names.distance-from-the-lef.note: Accessible label for the field that sets a point's distance from the left edge in the shape studio.

shape-editor.names.distance-from-the-rig.note: Accessible label for the field that sets a point's distance from the right edge in the shape studio.

shape-editor.names.distance-from-the-top.note: Accessible label for the field that sets a point's distance from the top edge in the shape studio.

shape-editor.names.drop.note: Name of a starter shape that looks like a water drop. A shape name, not the verb.

shape-editor.names.ellipse.note: Name of a starter shape that is a stretched circle, an oval.

shape-editor.names.esc-closes-a-window-t.text: Esc closes a window, then ends a drawing.
shape-editor.names.esc-closes-a-window-t.note: Line in the shortcut list. Esc is the key name. Describes the order Esc acts in.

shape-editor.names.h.note: Single-letter column label for the height field of a point or size. Stands for height.

shape-editor.names.heart.note: Name of a starter shape that looks like a heart.

shape-editor.names.hexagon.note: Name of a starter shape with six equal sides.

shape-editor.names.in-handle.note: Label of the curve control handle that shapes the line arriving at a smooth point.

shape-editor.names.intersect.note: Combine option that keeps only the overlap of the two shapes (verb).

shape-editor.names.keep-your-own-shapes-.text: Keep your own shapes for every dashboard with the free Magic Card Utils add-on.
shape-editor.names.keep-your-own-shapes-.note: Short pitch in the shape studio for the Magic Card Utils add-on. Tells the user it stores saved shapes for every dashboard.

shape-editor.names.lamp-on.note: Example shape name used as sample text in the name field hint. A lamp that is switched on.

shape-editor.names.leaf.note: Name of a starter shape that looks like a leaf, pointed at both ends.

shape-editor.names.left.note: Label for the left side of the card. Same English as the studio key.

shape-editor.names.living-room.note: Example shape name used as sample text in the name field hint. A room in a home.

shape-editor.names.no-change-a-sharp-cor.note: Description of the Square corner style in the shape studio corner panel.

shape-editor.names.notch.note: Name of a starter shape with square steps cut into its corners. A shape name.

shape-editor.names.notched.note: Corner style option: a square step cut into the corner. Adjective form of the Notch shape.

shape-editor.names.octagon.note: Name of a starter shape with eight equal sides.

shape-editor.names.out-handle.note: Label of the curve control handle that shapes the line leaving a smooth point.

shape-editor.names.pill.note: Name of a starter shape with fully rounded short ends, like a capsule. A shape name.

shape-editor.names.plus.note: Name of a starter shape that looks like a plus sign. A shape name.

shape-editor.names.right.note: Label for the right side of the card. Same English as the studio key.

shape-editor.names.right-click-long-pres.text: Right-click, long-press, the Menu key or Shift+F10 opens Outline actions.
shape-editor.names.right-click-long-pres.note: Line in the shortcut list. Menu and Shift+F10 are key names; Outline actions is a menu name.

shape-editor.names.round.note: Name of a corner style with a plain circular arc. Adjective, not the verb.

shape-editor.names.rounded.note: Corner style option for rounded corners. Adjective form of Round.

shape-editor.names.rounded-rectangle.note: Name of a starter shape, a rectangle with rounded corners.

shape-editor.names.row.note: Name of the preview size for a wide, short card. A card size, not a table row.

shape-editor.names.row-wide-360-x-120.note: Preview size option with its pixel size, width 360 by height 120. Keep the numbers.

shape-editor.names.scoop.note: Name of a starter shape with quarter circles cut into its corners. A shape name.

shape-editor.names.scooped.note: Corner style option: a quarter circle cut into the card. Adjective form of the Scoop shape.

shape-editor.names.semicircle.note: Name of a starter shape that is half a circle.

shape-editor.names.shield.note: Name of a starter shape that looks like a heraldic shield.

shape-editor.names.show-or-hide-panels-c.text: Show or hide panels: Ctrl+\ or ⌘\
shape-editor.names.show-or-hide-panels-c.note: Line in the shortcut list. The key combinations (Ctrl plus backslash, or Command plus backslash) stay as written.

shape-editor.names.speech-bubble.note: Name of a starter shape that looks like a comic speech bubble with a tail.

shape-editor.names.square.note: Name of a starter shape with four equal sides.

shape-editor.names.squircle.note: Name of a corner style between a circle and a square. A made-up design word (square plus circle).

shape-editor.names.star.note: Name of a starter shape that is a five-pointed star.

shape-editor.names.subtract.note: Combine option that cuts the second shape out of the outline (verb).

shape-editor.names.tab.note: Name of a starter shape that looks like a folder tab. A shape name, not the Tab key.

shape-editor.names.tab-into-the-canvas-t.text: Tab into the canvas, then [ and ] choose a point.
shape-editor.names.tab-into-the-canvas-t.note: Line in the shortcut list. Tab is the key, [ and ] are the bracket keys. Shorter variant of the studio hint.

shape-editor.names.tag.note: Name of a starter shape that looks like a price tag. A shape name.

shape-editor.names.the-library-is-full-d.text: The library is full. Delete a shape first.
shape-editor.names.the-library-is-full-d.note: Error in the shape studio when saving to a full library. Tells the user to delete a shape to make room.

shape-editor.names.this-shape-changed-wh.text: This shape changed while you were editing. Save as new, or reload it.
shape-editor.names.this-shape-changed-wh.note: Conflict error in the shape studio when saving a library shape that changed meanwhile. Offers saving as a new shape or reloading.

shape-editor.names.this-shape-is-too-big.text: This shape is too big for the library (8 KB).
shape-editor.names.this-shape-is-too-big.note: Save error. The 8 KB limit is fixed text. Same English as the studio key.

shape-editor.names.ticket.note: Name of a starter shape that looks like a ticket, with notches in its sides.

shape-editor.names.tile.note: Name of the preview size for a small square card. A card size.

shape-editor.names.tile-square-120-x-120.note: Preview size option with its pixel size, 120 by 120. Keep the numbers.

shape-editor.names.top.note: Label for the top side of the card. Same English as the studio key.

shape-editor.names.top-left-corner.note: Name of the first corner in the corner editor. Used with the other three corner names.

shape-editor.names.top-right-corner.note: Label for the top right corner in the shape studio corner panel and its accessible name.

shape-editor.names.triangle.note: Name of a starter shape with three sides.

shape-editor.names.two-notched-corners.note: Name of a corner preset in the shape studio. Describes a shape with two notched corners.

shape-editor.names.v-is-select-p-is-pen.text: V is Select. P is Pen.
shape-editor.names.v-is-select-p-is-pen.note: Line in the shortcut list. V and P are the keys; Select and Pen are the tool names, translate them like the tool labels.

shape-editor.names.w.note: Single-letter column label for the width field of a point or size. Stands for width.

shape-editor.names.wide.note: Name of a preview size for a wide card. A card size, adjective.

shape-editor.names.wide-banner.note: Name of the preview size for a very wide card. Same wording as the sized variant, without numbers.

shape-editor.names.wide-banner-720-x-200.note: Preview size option with its pixel size, 720 by 200. Keep the numbers.

shape-editor.names.x.note: Single-letter label for the horizontal coordinate field of a point. The axis letter, keep as X.

shape-editor.names.y.note: Single-letter label for the vertical coordinate field of a point. The axis letter, keep as Y.

shape-editor.names.your-account-can-use-.text: Your account can use the library but not change it. Ask an admin, or keep this shape in the card only.
shape-editor.names.your-account-can-use-.note: Permission error in the shape studio when a non-admin tries to save to the library. Suggests asking an admin or keeping the shape in the card.
